node.title: F2 admissible extension-degree and order classification
node.statement: Every official maximal rate-half row belongs to exactly one of 12 signed degree/order types. Plus branch: v2(p-1)>=41, k=1, e in {1,2,3,4,5,6}; v2(p-1)=40, k=2, e in {2,4}; v2(p-1)=39, k=4, e=4. Minus branch: v2(p+1)>=40, k=2, e in {2,4}; v2(p+1)=39, k=4, e=4. All 12 types are nonempty. Exactly seven are non-generating: the five plus k=1 rows with e=2,...,6 and the plus/minus k=2 rows with e=4. In particular, the field cap and elementary compositeness exclude every apparent e=6,k=2 row.
